about: Starting configuration for the Atlas (timeline + map). These are recommended defaults, not data: change them freely to fit the app's design. Every id used here exists in the database.

time_range.note: Signed years, negative = BCE. There is no year 0: when a computed year rounds to 0, snap to 1 (or -1 when moving backwards).

slider_scale.note: Piecewise-linear map from year to slider position (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge). Deep time is compressed so that the last 5,000 years, where most of the data sits, get most of the track. Interpolate linearly between neighbouring stops.

eras.note: Global bands for labelling the slider. They are a convenience: regional chronologies differ, so never use them to filter data.

bands.label: First burials and symbols
bands.blurb: The earliest signs of care for the dead and of symbolic thought. Evidence older than about 120,000 years is contested.

bands.label: Ice Age art and ritual
bands.blurb: Painted caves, carved figures, music and rich burials across Eurasia, Southeast Asia and Australia.

bands.label: Sanctuaries and first farmers
bands.blurb: Göbekli Tepe, ancestor skulls, house shrines and the first monuments.

bands.label: Temples, kings and writing
bands.blurb: Writing records the gods of Sumer, Egypt, the Indus and China; megaliths rise in Europe.

bands.label: Iron Age and the Axial Age
bands.blurb: Prophets, sages and teachers: Zoroaster, the Hebrew prophets, the Buddha, Mahavira, Confucius, Laozi and the Greek philosophers.

bands.label: Empires and world religions
bands.blurb: Buddhism, Christianity and Hinduism spread along roads and sea lanes; the old gods of Rome and Egypt fade.

bands.label: Faiths across continents
bands.blurb: Islam rises and spreads; Buddhism reaches Tibet, Japan and Southeast Asia; Christianity reaches Scandinavia and the steppe.

bands.label: Reformations and encounters
bands.blurb: Protestant Reformation, Sikhism, conquest and conversion in the Americas, Afro-diasporic religions born in the Atlantic world.

bands.label: Missions, revivals and new movements
bands.blurb: Global missions, African-initiated churches, the Bahá'í Faith, Spiritism, Theosophy and many new religions.

bands.label: Global spirituality and a secular age
bands.blurb: Pentecostal growth, new religious movements, revived pagan traditions, meditation going global and the rise of the non-religious.

event_density.note: How many timeline_events to show for the visible time window. Pick the first rule whose span_at_least the window meets.

presence_rendering.rule: A presence row is visible at year Y when year_start <= Y and (year_end is null or year_end >= Y).
presence_rendering.fade_in: Fade in across the row's start window, from year_start to year_start_latest, so uncertain beginnings look soft.
presence_rendering.fade_out: Fade out after year_end over a short span (about 2% of the visible window).
presence_rendering.size: Scale area by prominence (1-5). Prominence is an approximate share of the local population, not a headcount; say so in the legend.
presence_rendering.country_rows: Rows with no place_id sit at a country centroid and stand for diffuse presence across a region. Draw them as large soft blobs, not pins. Avoid filling modern country outlines for pre-modern years: those borders did not exist.
presence_rendering.place_rows: Rows with a place_id are a specific city or site: draw them as smaller, sharper points.
presence_rendering.auto_origin: Rows with auto = 1 are generated origin points; a gentle pulse at the tradition's start works well.

family_groups.note: Twenty families are too many separate colours for a map. Give each group one hue and each family within it a shade.

interaction_groups.note: Group the 14 interaction types into three arc styles.

lineage.meaning: one tradition grows out of, splits from, reforms or revives another

exchange.meaning: ideas and practices flow between traditions

interaction_groups.drawing: Draw arcs from the source tradition's origin point (traditions.origin_lat/lon) to the interaction's lat/lon. year_end null = still ongoing; year_end = year_start = a single moment.

groups.label: Outsider records
groups.caution: Accounts written by missionaries, officials or anthropologists; some are contested by the communities described.

practice_links.note: Bridges between the Atlas and the app's existing sections. Every practice is also an Atlas filter.
practice_links.sound_caution: Binaural beats are a modern technique. Present them as a modern way of working with sound and rhythm, alongside the ancient practices, never as something ancient peoples used.

labels.use_data_labels: Prefer the date_label strings stored in every table.
labels.year_format: Negative years: 'N BCE' (thousands separator from 10,000 BCE). 1-999: 'N CE'. 1000 onwards: plain 'N'. Prefix 'c. ' when circa = 1.
